title: Small first, check what ships (11 Nov 2026)
summary: Atlassian puts a fine-tuned 4B model in front of a 20B safety model and halves moderation latency, a 400M job-posting extractor matches a 27B model but only stores salaries whose digits appear in the text, Mobile AI Factory builds fine-tuned small models per phone and shows why you score the exact quantized file, an 11 MB Russian embedder drops the transformer at serving time, and an audit finds that LLM annotators, even after fine-tuning, follow old labels more than new definitions.
